summary: Friday demand scan for the geography channel: added 6 topics from the niche's biggest single-idea Shorts (Antarctica 16M, Point Nemo 10M, Darién Gap 9.7M, Alaska sale 6.1M, sea drop 3.5M, ice age 216K), each with sourced fixed figures.
why: All six beat the open feed on score (7.72-9.04; only Pangaea is higher). The market scan is three days old and already mined, so tonight's demand came from 12 YouTube searches. No craft proposal: nothing new beyond the challengers already queued.

findings.title: Who Owns Antarctica? 16M views on a 2.1M channel (7.6x)
findings.detail: Added as a high-priority why_shaped topic; 58 treaty parties checked on the Secretariat's page tonight.

findings.title: Point Nemo: 10M on 2.1M subs, plus 3.3M on a 2.7K channel (1,213x)
findings.detail: The place farthest from land and a spacecraft graveyard; added as a high-priority topic.

findings.title: Why Nobody Can Cross Darien Gap: 9.7M on 392K subs (24.7x)
findings.detail: Told as geography (the 106 km gap in a 30,000 km highway), not the migrant crossing.

findings.title: Our worst Shorts by avg viewed are places viewers can't picture
findings.detail: Tristan da Cunha 48.8% and English cities 54.1%, against Britain's power station 82.3% and Malacca 80.7%, so tonight's topics are all famous places.

findings.title: Egypt-on-the-Nile is a crowded lane
findings.detail: 5 Shorts this week, none above 5K views; skipped.

changes.title: 6 topics added to the feed
changes.detail: Darién Gap, Antarctica, Point Nemo, Alaska sale (why_shaped); sea dropped 1,000 m, ice age returned (what_if_world).
